watch.summary: The streamer laughs heartily while watching a hiding player stand completely in the open, miraculously unnoticed by the seeker until a sudden face-to-face realization.

beats.what: The streamer watches a player in bright clothes standing exposed near stairs.
The hider marvels in voice chat that he hasn't been spotted yet.
The seeker turns around and realizes the hider is standing right next to him.
The seeker shouts in surprise as the streamer cracks up laughing.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: How has he not seen me yet?
watch.why: The dramatic irony of a player hiding in plain sight generates great tension, yielding a hilarious visual payoff when the seeker finally turns around.
